prompt: Set up a minimal Agent Sync project scaffold in the current directory. Create the standard collaboration files for a small demo project named "alpha-notes": TASK.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTEXT.md, WEEKLY-REPORT.md, and llms.txt. The files should be consistent with the Agent Sync workflow, include the project name, and contain a few realistic starter items. Also make sure the changelog includes at least one tagged entry and an agent identity.
